author: Learn Linux TV
description:
Ubuntu 26.10 is here, and in this video I’ll walk you through the entire installation process from start to finish. We’ll go over what you’ll need before you begin, take Ubuntu 26.10 for a test drive in live mode, step through the installer, and then log in to the finished install to check things out.
